name: pipeline-fix
description: A failing CI pipeline made green: read the failing GitHub Actions run (or reproduce locally), find the cause, fix it in the workspace, run the same job steps locally in the sandbox until they pass, gates, push a branch and pull request with publish_branch, and watch the new run - back to diagnosis if it fails again.

branch.description: The branch whose CI is failing

runId.description: A specific failing run id (default: the newest failing run on the branch)

source.description: "github" to read the failing run from GitHub and push the fix, "local" to reproduce and fix with the workflow files only (no GitHub access)

job.description: The failing job id in that workflow

cause.description: The root cause, one or two sentences

fixed.description: ci run-local passes for the job

commit.description: The commit sha that was pushed

pushedBranch.description: The branch the fix was pushed to

diagnose.title: Find the failure and its cause
diagnose.prompt:
A CI pipeline is failing. Find the failing step and its root cause; do not change files yet. Load the ci-debugging skill.

Source: {{input.source}}. Repo: {{input.repo}}. Branch: {{input.branch}}. Run: {{input.runId}}
- github: ci runs (branch, status failure) unless a run id is given, then ci logs for the run.
- local: ci lint, then ci run-local for each job of each workflow in .github/workflows until one fails.
Classify the failure (code, workflow, environment, flaky) as the skill describes.
Earlier attempt, if any: {{feedback}}

Report the failing workflow file, job, step, the error, and the cause.

fix.title: Fix and reproduce locally

publish.title: Push the fix
publish.prompt: Publish the fix with the publish_branch tool: a branch and pull request titled after the cause, with a body that says what failed (workflow {{state.workflowFile}}, job {{state.job}}), the cause ({{state.cause}}), the fix, and that ci run-local passed. Report the branch and the commit sha it pushed.

watch.title: Watch the new run
watch.prompt: Watch the CI run for the fix: ci {"action": "watch", "repo": "{{input.repo}}", "branch": "{{state.pushedBranch}}", "sha": "{{state.commit}}"} (omit repo if it is empty). Report the result; if it failed, the failing step and error.
